nom: Drunk Elephant Kamili Cream Body Cleanser

avis.texte: I have been looking for a mild body wash. It is perfect. Lathers well and doesn't leave a residue. I am left feeling clean and refreshed.

avis.titre: Feels nice but not worth the price
avis.texte: The product feels nice but I don't think I'll be going back for another bottle once this one is finished. It's pricey and I don't see any major changes in my skin that would warrant dropping the amount of money a second time

avis.titre: I keep an extra one in reserve.
avis.texte: Hate to run out of this one. It's my go to body cleanser. Never irritates my skin, and I have hyper-sensitive skin.
I can almost use this like an in shower lotion but it's hard to get enough for the whole body since it doesn't foam up that much. smells to me like shea
bought as a gift for a picky friend - she loved, said fragrance is nice, very light and dissipates quickly

avis.titre: Please make the pump packaging permanent
avis.texte: The 8oz bottle is very annoying to use in the shower. Please make the pump packaging permanent. Now for the actual review, the cleanser has a very mild almond scent that dissipates quickly. It's low foam and not too drying compared to most other foaming washes, though I still sometimes have to use lotion after showering with this.

Works well with water softener water as rinses easily. DE touts recyclable containers but the containers are all about marketing, bulky, opaque and unnecessary. Also product @8 oz is ridiculously expensive. I noticed, like your shampoos and conditioners you no longer have pump bottle sizes. Also you experimented with refill bags versus bottles on one of the shampoos, but no longer available either. You are not a Green Company, just claims to be one with so much waste packaging and now gimmicky smaller sizes with auto fill program versus larger size of product. Terribly disappointed!!

Love that leaves no fragrance bc I have not found anything else that is fragrance free that doesn't smell like glue. It is expensive but when only option due to illnesses, price becomes worthwhile (as it has been impossible to find substitute in the months it has been out stock).
It is so soft and genial on my skin and me and my daughter love using it !
Beautiful body wash. Love that it's ph balanced for all areas, and works great for moisture, I don't even need lotion after, even in the winter!

I love the body cleanser and how it feels on my sensitive skin. I have not had a reaction to it and my skin is calm when using this. I just need the bottle to be easier to squeeze!! I would have purchased the larger size with the pump but it has been out of stock.
Love this gentle body wash: I use it daily. It's my favorite go-to!

avis.titre: Works well on sensitive skin and has a very light citrus fra
avis.texte: I love this body wash because it keeps me moisturized and feeling fresh throughout the day and takes away the dirt and sweat of the day without stripping the skin of all of its oils.

avis.titre: Kamili Cream Body Cleanser is so refreshing!
avis.texte: I received this cleanser as a free deluxe sample due for spending a certain amount on my order. After one use, my skin instantly felt refreshed and moisturized. I will definitely be purchasing the full size!

I am obsessed with this body cleanser! I look forward to using it each time I shower and my skin loves it too (kp prone and sensitive). I personally love the scent and it doesn't linger after use but can see how it's not for everyone. The packaging needs work, it can be very hard to open the caps so I keep all DE body/hair products open because it's not worth the hassle. Also the shape makes it difficult to empty the bottles and to stand top-down. I'll be repurchasing this for as long as I can but hope they're open to perfecting the packaging to the quality of the product :)

avis.titre: This will always be in my shower
avis.texte: I dont even know how many bottles ive gone through at this point. Now I've noticed my husband is using it also. Everyone who has tried it, loves it like i do.

I like this gentle cleanser very much. Its hydrating, smooth, and refreshing. I do wish there was more product for the price point, at least 10 oz. My skin feels clean, soft, and moisturized. I don't have that taut, dry feeling like some body cleansers. Great product overall. I do wish more product came in the container for the price, as stated.
This was a new product for me. It leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling dried out.

avis.titre: Price is ridiculous but it's still all I use!
avis.texte: I started using this body wash almost 2 years ago. Now don't get me wrong, the price is ridiculous, but this is really great for sensitive skin all over and I can use it *everywhere* instead of having to use 2 different products. It smells amazing and a little does go a long way, surprisingly.

I like this body wash a lot. The scent is light, but delicious. A hint of almond. The only reason I did 4 stars and not 5 is because it doesn't leave you feeling super clean. Like, it doesn't lather (which I know is a good thing), but i often clean with cetaphil wash for rough and bumpy skin and then follow up with this just bc it smells so good.
This smells so good! I love how it isn't so bubbly that all of it doesn't just fall of my loofah. It is so great to pair with the Sili body lotion. And the packaging of course is super cute!
A friend recommended this product to me because I was having breakouts on my skin. It's helped clear them up and my skin also feels so soft!
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT IT SMELLS SO GOOD I DEFINITELY RECOMMEND IT!!

ok so i found this body wash to be sooooo disappointing . it's not like terrible or anything but i definitely wouldn't buy it again and it's 100% not worth the price. it's just an average product. nothing special.

Something about this scent sends me to a state of nostalgia. Can't quite place it. Would purchase again. Feels nourishing and interested in their other products. Have tried the serum as well. Not reasonably priced so we'll see since I used a gift card

avis.titre: Drunk Elephant 10% AHA Blend Marula + Shea
avis.texte: I use this together with the First Aid Beauty KP Scrub and my arms look the best they ever have. It exfoliates but its not incredibly hydrating so I recommend switching off or following up with something thicker like Bum Bum Sol de Janeiro. Also, don't use after shaving your legs - it stings like crazy.

avis.titre: Great products even better customer service
avis.texte: I do like DE products because they're clean. My husband even likes the lip balm. But this past order, part of my shipment was damaged during transit. I contacted DE and let them know what happened. They replaced the damaged products right away. I will continue to shop with this company and purchase their superior skin care products!

avis.titre: HANDS DOWN THE BEST BODY WASH EVER!!!
avis.texte: Is it expensive, yeah but you get what you pay for and you only need a little squirt to get the job done. Your skin is left feeling soft and hydrated and never dried out like most soaps and body washes. I promise it's worth every dime.
keep skin smooth,don't hurt skin,skin not dry out, i am dry skin so it is good for dry skin person
Makes skin clean ,softens, and refreshes skin. I definitely recommend and buying more as you read this!

Hello my friends I can used this product after today every night it's super cheap and healthy for my body I relax after used

I was looking for a cleanser / shaving soap / moisturizer. This fits the bill completely! I only need a small amount each time I shower, sot the price is worth it being it will last me a very long time! Fits the bill completely for all 3 needs.

Didn‚Äôt appreciate the smell and it‚Äôs really hard to get enough product out of the bottle. avis.titre: The only body wash I will use

Little bit on your body scrubber goes a long ways since it lathers so nice! #influenster #bodycare #drunkelephant #wash Drunk Elephant Kamilitm Cream Body Cleanser 80 Oz 240 Ml

This is a well-formulated body wash. It has a an effective pH that won't dry out your skin while still doing a good job of cleaning. The pH of this product is actually an appropriate one for use on the face, not just the body. I've heard some reviews by people with body acne saying that this has helped them with that problem—it's not something I struggle with myself, so I can't vouch for that. Personally, I don't think I'll be repurchasing this because it didn't blow my mind and it's quite expensive. I'm also not a huge fan of the almond-cherry scent that the brand has chosen for the whole hair and body range.
My new favorite body wash! I have sensitive skin and this body wash is perfect. It also smells amazing.

I love that this cleanser does not strip my skin. I was skeptical when I first pumped it out and it seemed like a gel rather than a creamy cleanser. I shouldn‚Äôt have worried. Very nice smell that sort of reminds me of almonds.
I have very dry skin and this is the first body wash that soothed my skin and I did not itch after showering. I highly recommend this cleanser for sensitive skin as well as dry.

I first received a sample bottle and after the first time using it I knew I needed the big mamma bottle. Creates lots of suds, gets you clean and soft. Has a light almond smell which I like, not over powering. Really like that it has a ph rating.
I had gone through a few of these bottles when I discovered the larger size with a pump. Thank you for that. Its more convenient. I felt a difference the first time I used this with the body lotion.

The scent is like an almond/bamboo smell it wasn't my favorite at first but it's grown on me it is a clean scent. Oh my gosh. This stuff is my favorite! A little goes a long way, and the smell is amazing! 😍 It's definitely a product I will keep buying. It does wonders for my dry skin and leaves me feeling fresh.

For many years I've been looking for that perfect body wash that wouldn't make me feel dry. Started using this about a year ago and I haven't looked back since! Stoked that I can get my Ulta points for this now :D

My new favorite body wash. It makes my skin feel amazingly clean, soft, and soothed. I will be buying this forever. Other cleansers make me itchy with added fragrances… this is natural and smells great but light!
it's soft, subtle, and smells absolutely delicious. one of my all time favorite body washes. doesn't break my skin out and makes me smell like an orange dreamsicle. love love love.

So lovely, and a little goes a long way! Smells great and doesn‚Äôt cause breakouts!

This is a great body wash. Smells great, creates a smooth and creamy lather. I am thrilled and would absolutely buy it again. It is a large bottle too.
This is a very gentle cleanser with a subtle scent (which is nice). A little goes a long way! It leaves my skin soft. I would like to order a bigger bottle to use more liberally.

For me, the body wash is on point. It‚Äôs light. My skin feels cleaner after use without feeling like I‚Äôve doused it with chemicals. My skin remains soft, doesn‚Äôt dry out, but also helps balance the oily spots

I have extremely sensitive skin and this cleanser is so gentle. Also the smell is heavenly.
Love this body wash! Very smooth and leaves your skin feeling great.

I really like this cleanser. I was special looking for a ph balanced cleanser for my sensitive skin and this is wonderful. I also like the soft scent.
This goes on so creamy. Smells amazing and literally a little goes a long way.
Best cleanser ever!!!! Cleared up my body acne and is such a gentle cleanser!!!!

I use this body wash daily and a little goes a long way. I have sensitive skin and this wash keeps my skin soft and feeling clean/fresh after each use. It‚Äôs a bonus that it smells wonderful.

I love this lotion. There are so many great oils, emulsifiers, antioxidants, and skin identical ingredients in this lotion but.... please remove the ascorbyl palmitate. I would have given 5 stars but for that.
Perfect trial size. Now I wish I'd have purchased the lotion. Loved it!
Nice clean feeling, nicely scented, suds well. Will buy again.
I don't have much to say about the body cleanser, but the lotion is a lovely texture and absorbed very easily. I would purchase this product in the future.
This is the only body wash I will use now. I have really bad dry skin and have tried everything. This is amazing!
